quality_boundary: This Phase 14 inventory verifies Nagasaki's current 2026-2030 latter basic plan, rolling 2026-2028 implementation route, explicit not-yet-published current evaluation boundary, FY2026 budget route, and FY2024 front-plan settlement route. Missing evaluation results are not inferred and no independent achievement or causal judgment is introduced.
